title: Where is the Gridless Sea

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Salt Pete has been trying to contact you again through... unorthodox means.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Salt Pete has been trying to contact you again through... unorthodox means.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I believe they call it "Morse Code". I took the liberty of translating for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe they call it "Morse Code". I took the liberty of translating for you.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Sometimes when I tell you I am the most intelligent, sophisticated assistant that has ever existed, I think you don't believe me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sometimes when I tell you I am the most intelligent, sophisticated assistant that has ever existed, I think you don't believe me.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: That you don't believe me? Only you would know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That you don't believe me? Only you would know.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Well, there's many ways to measure such claims, but most metrics would align with my conclusions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, there's many ways to measure such claims, but most metrics would align with my conclusions.
Yes I am.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: He has sent you the first "clue"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He has sent you the first "clue"?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yes. He says: "Spare the rod and spoil the secret. The oil is rigged in your favor. Cast your gaze down, the pelagic depths hold the first prize."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. He says: "Spare the rod and spoil the secret. The oil is rigged in your favor. Cast your gaze down, the pelagic depths hold the first prize."

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Indeed. And not a very good one. How thrilling!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. And not a very good one. How thrilling!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: He is. Have you deciphered his clue?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He is. Have you deciphered his clue?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I believe he wants you to go fishing near the oil rig.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe he wants you to go fishing near the oil rig.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Oh, and he left an old fishing rod for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, and he left an old fishing rod for you.
It's the gesture that counts.
Explain.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How did you pick up morse code?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How did you pick up morse code?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How did you pick up morse code?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How did you pick up morse code?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does he want?
Is that true?
Are you the most intelligent?
And you're modest too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You are pretty smart I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are pretty smart I guess.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You are pretty smart I guess.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You are pretty smart I guess.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what did Salt Pete say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what did Salt Pete say?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what did Salt Pete say?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what did Salt Pete say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Clue?
A riddle!
... A riddle.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess he is telling us where to go with the boat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess he is telling us where to go with the boat.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess he is telling us where to go with the boat.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess he is telling us where to go with the boat.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I got it. Let's go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I got it. Let's go.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I got it. Let's go.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I got it. Let's go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A little help?
Right. Then let's go.
How nice of him.
But I already have one.
Agreed.
